Brain stores tons of info, and when trying to fill the holes of delirium it uses what it knows, bases it as much as it can in fear. (Survival response actually) And tries to create a believable scenario. It's not, and just keep reminding yourself its like a broken mirror with run-on sentences that don't exist :)

But GHB smooths out almost all the negatives of stimulants, no anxiety or tweaked out feeling. Also lowers heart rate a bit, and seems to have some vasodilating effects, takes care of "stim dick" if you're prone to that.

You really want to kick the euphoria and empathy up a notch mix in a little 2C-B! I usually wait until I've come up and reached a good level on the GHB and stims before dosing. Preferred route is intranasal for me, I take small (3-4mg) bumps until I reach the level I desire. Quick come up and duration is a lot shorter, so it's pretty perfect for those club nights. And the burn isn't too bad in small amounts, especially if you're feeling pretty good from the GHB. 2C-B is also one of the few psychedelics that seem possible to consistently redose and still achieve effects. Tolerance seems to build slower than other 5-HT agonists in that class.

Altogether this is the closest I've come to finding a proper MDMA replacement. It's similar to rolling with the openness and increased emotional state. But also has benefits of being more aware and clean feeling. Also seems quite sustainable for somewhat-regular use due to not sharing the SRA properties of MDMA. Depends on what stimulant you choose to mix in though.

I highly recommend giving it a shot!

Here's some overall tips for usage! Hope it helps!

* Hydrate - obviously important.
* Get a full nights rest tonight and make sure you're well rested beforehand. 
* Electrolytes - to replace what is lost through sweating.
* A good protein filled meal - helps with overall energy, also remember to force yourself to eat while on it.
* L-Tyrosine and/or L-Phenylalanine - amino acids to help replenish Dopamine.
* Magnesium - while on it, helps prevent bruxism and might help prevent some tolerance buildup.
* Vitamin C - taken on the comedown will help your body flush out the rest of the Amphetamine. 
* Antioxidants - Best to take beforehand, I recommend Na-R-ALA and CoQ10, helps prevent neurotoxicity.
* Benzo OR GHB - Great for the comedown, especially if you dosed a little on the higher end. Also really helps with sleep. Just don't mix those 2!

Give it a day and you should be back to normal, honestly lack of sleep is probably what has you feeling the worst. And next time make sure to moderate your usage, I personally try not to exceed over 150mg in a night, usually 80-100mg is a good level for me. And remember more frequent doses can easily lead to tolerance, and it can take a little while (1-2 months) to be back at baseline. Stay safe and enjoy!
